brief: The canvas displays abstract, glowing data grids representing multi-dimensional tensors. These grids flow across the screen, appearing to compress, shift, and transform through a series of interconnected nodes. Colors represent the intensity or dimension of the data passing through the system, creating a constantly evolving, intricate flow of light and geometric shapes. When the user clicks anywhere on the canvas, a new input prompt activates, causing the central data stream to recalculate its flow and display a radically transformed output pattern.

statement: This sketch visualizes abstract data grids representing multi-dimensional tensors flowing through space. The system consists of interconnected nodes that influence the movement of thousands of glowing particles in real-time. Each particle's position shifts based on its distance from these nodes, creating complex, evolving patterns. When clicked, the central data stream recalculates its flow by relocating the influencing nodes and reconfiguring the connections between particles, producing radically different output patterns while maintaining the overall abstract structure of data flow visualization.
